title: A Syntactic Approach to Ulmer's Bialgebras: a Lean 4 formalization
description: A formalization in Lean 4 and Mathlib of the results of the paper A Syntactic Approach to Ulmer's Bialgebras: 175 checked statements, proved with the axioms propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice only. The paper in paper/ is released under CC BY 4.0. Exported at commit 9e9491abe72d2b97637162feea52474234db274b.
notes: The author is supported by an Aspirant fellowship of the F.R.S.-FNRS.
